description: Language profiles (SPEC 5.4): number words in the message are message numbers. A case's "profile" names a file in profiles/.

cases.name: yirmi is 20 with the Turkish profile
cases.message: Yılmaz Market'e yirmi koli domates gönder

cases.name: without a profile, 20 is invented
cases.message: Yılmaz Market'e yirmi koli domates gönder

cases.name: iki yüz elli üç is 253, not 250
cases.message: Yilmaz Market: iki yüz elli üç adet domates
cases.plan: (plan "x" (do (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "domates" quantity 253) (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "domates" quantity 250)))

cases.name: words written together: yirmibeş, ikiyüzelli
cases.message: Yilmaz Market: yirmibeş koli domates, ikiyüzelli kilo biber
cases.plan: (plan "x" (do (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "domates" quantity 25) (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "biber" quantity 250)))

cases.name: iki üç koli is 2 and 3, not 5
cases.message: Yilmaz Market: iki üç koli domates
cases.plan: (plan "x" (do (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "domates" quantity 3) (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "domates" quantity 5)))

cases.name: digits and a scale word: 2 bin, 1,5 milyon
cases.message: Yilmaz Market: 2 bin koli domates, 1,5 milyon gram biber
cases.plan: (plan "x" (do (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "domates" quantity 2000) (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "biber" quantity 1500000)))

cases.name: upper case: BİN İKİ YÜZ
cases.message: YILMAZ MARKET: BİN İKİ YÜZ DOMATES

cases.name: letters are not folded: ön is not on (10)
cases.message: Yilmaz Market: domatesleri ön kapıya bırakın

cases.name: spellings without Turkish letters are listed: dort, bes
cases.message: Yilmaz Market: dort koli domates, bes koli biber
cases.plan: (plan "x" (do (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "domates" quantity 4) (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "biber" quantity 5)))

cases.name: not covered: bin buçuk is 1000, never 1500
cases.message: Yilmaz Market: bin buçuk koli domates
cases.plan: (plan "x" (do (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "domates" quantity 1000) (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "domates" quantity 1500)))

cases.name: English: two hundred and five, twenty-five
cases.message: Yilmaz Market: two hundred and five tomatoes and twenty-five peppers
cases.plan: (plan "x" (do (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "tomatoes" quantity 205) (erp.add_order_line customer "Yilmaz Market" product "peppers" quantity 25)))

cases.name: English is not Turkish: yirmi means nothing with the English profile
